Title: Chat Provider Architecture (Ollama, GitHub Copilot, OpenAI-Compatible)
Content: MemorySmith supports three chat providers via IChatProvider: (1) OllamaChatProvider — local REST/NDJSON to /api/chat with Ollama-specific tool envelope formatting, num_ctx governance, thinking content extraction, and streaming; (2) GitHubCopilotChatProvider — SDK-based via GitHub.Copilot.SDK with event-driven streaming via SessionEvent, reflection-based SDK property probing, and dynamic model discovery; (3) OpenAICompatibleChatProvider — generic REST/NDJSON provider at MemorySmith.App/Services/OpenAICompatibleChatProvider.cs supporting OpenAI, DeepSeek, and Anthropic API-compatible endpoints with configurable endpoint, model, and API key. All three are registered in MemorySmithChatSetup.cs via AddHttpClient (Ollama and OpenAI-compatible) or direct singleton (GitHubCopilot). Provider discovery in Chat.razor is dynamic via IEnumerable[IChatProvider]. The AdminSettingsService provider choice list and ChatModelProfileService.SupportedProviders include all three options. ChatOptions holds per-provider fields (OllamaEndpoint, OllamaModel, GitHubModel, OpenAIEndpoint, OpenAIModel, OpenAIApiKey). ChatController.ResolveProvider() matches by provider name string.
